course.title: Foundation Engineering
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: Design a combined footing for two columns C1 and C2 located at a centre to centre distance of 15 ft. Column C1 is 15 inch X 15 inch in size and carries a load of 175 kips. Column C2 is 18 inch X 18 inch in size and carries a load of 225 kips. The safe bearing capacity of soil is 1.25 tsf. Use $f _ { c } ^ { \prime } = 3 0 0 0$ psi and $f _ { s } = 2 4 0 0 0$ psi. Show the reinforcement details.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
